text:
Vincent Schaefer's co-inventor on the 1947 "Electrical Indicator of Mechanical Expansion" patent was most likely Katharine Burr Blodgett, the General Electric physicist known for monomolecular film coatings and non-reflective glass. This replaces my earlier guess of Bernard Vonnegut. I'm going on the team note's description and my own recollection that Blodgett and Schaefer worked together at GE, and I haven't checked the patent record.

CONFIDENCE: 80
